Q1: Which part of coding-workflows should this issue change?
Choices:
A. The issue → PR pipeline phases: clarify, plan, implement or review/autofix workflows and their prompts (RECOMMENDED)
B. The orchestrator: orchestrate / orchestrate_poll, integration-sync, waves and labels
C. The AI memory subsystem (`scripts/ai_memory.py`, `scripts/memory_helpers.sh`, the `ai-memory` branch)
D. How consumer repos are onboarded and kept up to date (update-workflows, seed-repo, wrapper pins)
E. Documentation only (README.md, `docs/how-it-works.md`, agents.md fragments)
F. Other: reply with the workflow or script path
Q2: What kind of improvement do you want?
Choices:
A. Fix a specific bug or failure you have seen: reply with the run URL, log excerpt or steps to reproduce (RECOMMENDED)
B. Lower cost or runtime: fewer tokens, fewer GitHub API calls, faster runs
C. Make it more reliable: fewer stalls, retries or self-heal gaps
D. Add a new feature or behaviour: reply with a short description
E. Clearer docs, logs or messages only, with no change in behaviour
Q3: How will we know the work is done?
Choices:
A. You will give a concrete pass/fail condition in your `/answer` (for example "run X no longer fails with Y") (RECOMMENDED)
B. Focused contract tests that pin the new behaviour pass in CI
C. The planner proposes the criteria and you confirm them when approving the plan
